title: Fixed-grid simplified LPPLS diagnostics

paper.title: A Stable and Robust Calibration Scheme of the Log-Periodic Power Law Model

hypothesis: A preregistered LPPLS grid can report fit residual and critical-time dispersion without selecting a visually attractive crash date.
causalBoundary: Every fit window ends at t, all grids are supplied before evaluation, and outputs are stability diagnostics rather than future event labels.
counterfactual: Geometric random walks and fixed trend controls should expose whether apparent log-periodicity is merely flexible curve fitting.
